title: N-ary groups of panmagic permutations from the Post coset theorem
summary: Panmagic permutations are permutations whose matrices are panmagic squares, better known as solutions to the modular n-queens problem, configurations of n non-attacking queens on a toroidal nxn chessboard. Some of them, affine panmagic permutations, can be conveniently described by linear formulas of modular arithmetic, and we show that their sets are a generalization of groups with N-ary multiplication instead of binary one.
